versions.content: To serialize the required AUTOSAR data types (signed- and unsigned integer) into the response message of OBD Service $01 responses the target endianness configured in DcmDspPidDataEndianness shall be con- sidered for DcmDspPidData elements having DcmDspPidDataUsePort set to USE_DATA_SENDER_RECEIVER or USE_DATA_SENDER_RECEIVER_AS_SERVICE . In case DcmDspPidDataEndianness is not present, the DcmDspDataDefault- Endianness shall be used instead.
